author: pk910
content:
heya,
uhm, just digging into this thread 😄  there seems to be a couple of questions:
first,  the boost value for builder api bids on buildoor instances is a config thing.  We haven't ever changed it,  but increased the p2p side,  so the api bids were actually less valuable then p2p bids..  I've updated all buildoor instances a moment ago, so builder api bids are 1.5x the p2p bid value 🙂

rel sampling multiple bids:   buildoor does currently not update its bid.   the bid is created slightly before the slot start and buildoor returns that bid only.
that basically also answers the timeout part:  the getExecutionPayloadBid call does not do any heavy logic.  Its returning a cached bid.  should be super fast,  but our builders are spread across regions, so you'll likely see real RTT delay with some.
